title: Convert the repo into a Cargo workspace with crate skeletons

user_story.i_want: the repository organised as a Cargo workspace with one crate per component
user_story.so_that: services share code through libraries instead of copy-paste, and build and test together

description: Turn the root `Cargo.toml` into a *virtual manifest* (`[workspace]`, no `[package]`) with `members = ["crates/*"]`. Create the crates from docs/architecture.md: libraries `stratum-core`, `stratum-aws`, `stratum-db`; binaries `stratum-ingest-api`, `stratum-firehose`, `stratum-scheduler`, `stratum-worker`, `stratum-cli`. Each binary just prints its name for now. The current hello-world `src/main.rs` goes away. Shared metadata goes in `[workspace.package]` and shared dependency versions in `[workspace.dependencies]`. Node analogy: npm workspaces, where `cargo run -p <crate>` is like `npm run -w <pkg>`.

acceptance_criteria.then: all 8 crates compile with zero warnings

acceptance_criteria.when: I run `cargo run -p stratum-ingest-api` (and each other binary)
it calls a `pub fn` from stratum-core via a path dependency
acceptance_criteria.then: it compiles and runs, which proves cross-crate visibility

acceptance_criteria.given: a dependency used by two crates
acceptance_criteria.then: its version is declared once in `[workspace.dependencies]` and referenced with `workspace = true`
there is exactly one Cargo.lock and one target/ directory, both at the root

rust_concepts: lib.rs vs main.rs (library vs binary targets)
Crate names with hyphens become underscores in code (`stratum_core`)
technical_notes: A virtual manifest must set `resolver` explicitly; use "3" to match edition 2024.
`cargo new --lib crates/stratum-core` creates a library crate; without `--lib` you get a binary.
Cargo 1.100 warns about [workspace.dependencies] entries no crate uses (`unused_workspace_dependencies`), so stratum-aws/stratum-db are added there only when a crate starts depending on them.

references.title: The Rust Book ch.7: Packages, crates & modules
The Rust Book ch.14.3: Cargo workspaces

activity.note: Implemented by Claude at Rama's request. Virtual manifest (resolver 3, workspace.package incl. rust-version 1.85) + 8 crates under crates/. Binaries print their name via stratum_core::banner (path dependency through [workspace.dependencies]). Clean build: 0 warnings; fmt, clippy -D warnings and tests pass. Old src/main.rs removed.
